links.comparator_used: Each decision-only model (Jev, OpenAI Decisions) or the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) used alone, without pairing
links.outcome: Framing sensitivity: extra decisions changed per 100 by added labels or pressure cues compared with neutral wording, with triage accuracy as a secondary check
links.effect: Added labels or pressure cues changed 13.4 more decisions per 100 for the decision models and 14.0 for the LLM. Pairing reduced this to 2.6, about 81% lower in development and 42% to 48% lower in held-out reports. Triage accuracy stayed near 81% to 82%.
links.tradeoff: The paired Decisions workflow cost at most US$0.77 per 1,000 entries. The authors describe the work as an early proof of concept.
links.quote: Pairing reduced this to 2.6, about 81% lower in development and 42% to 48% lower in held-out reports.

design_hint: pairing decision models with LLMs to mitigate framing bias and sensitivity
